lines.name: Grace
lines.en: Hello! Welcome to the museum. How can I help you?
lines.ko: 안녕하세요! 미술관에 오신 걸 환영해요. 무엇을 도와드릴까요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: I'd like a ticket for the Yoo Youngkuk exhibition.
lines.ko: 유영국 전시 표 한 장 주세요.

lines.name: Grace
lines.en: One ticket for the Yoo Youngkuk exhibition. That's fifteen thousand won. Would you like an audio guide, too?
lines.ko: 유영국 전시 표 한 장이요. 만 오천 원이에요. 오디오 가이드도 필요하세요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: Yes, I'd like an audio guide, please.

lines.name: Grace
lines.en: Sure! It's three thousand won more. Would you like it in Korean or English?
lines.ko: 네! 삼천 원 추가돼요. 한국어로 드릴까요, 영어로 드릴까요?

lines.name: Grace
lines.en: Korean. OK! The total is eighteen thousand won. How would you like to pay?
lines.ko: 한국어요. 알겠습니다! 모두 만 팔천 원이에요. 어떻게 결제하시겠어요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: By card, please. Here is my card.

lines.name: Grace
lines.en: Thank you! Here's your ticket and the audio guide. The exhibition is on the second floor. Do you have any questions?
lines.ko: 감사합니다! 표랑 오디오 가이드 여기 있어요. 전시는 2층이에요. 궁금한 점 있으세요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: Can I take photos in the exhibition?

lines.name: Grace
lines.en: Yes, you can. But please don't use flash. Do you need a locker for your bag?
lines.ko: 네, 찍으셔도 돼요. 그런데 플래시는 쓰지 말아 주세요. 가방 보관할 사물함 필요하세요?

lines.name: Grace
lines.en: OK! Is this your first visit to our museum?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: No, I visited the museum last year. It has so many great collections.
lines.ko: 아니요, 작년에 와 봤어요. 좋은 소장품이 정말 많더라고요.

lines.name: Grace
lines.en: Thank you! I'm glad you came back. What did you like the most last time?
lines.ko: 감사합니다! 다시 와 주셔서 기뻐요. 지난번엔 뭐가 제일 좋으셨어요?

lines.name: Grace
lines.en: Then you'll love this exhibition! Yoo Youngkuk is a big part of Korean modern art. Enjoy!
lines.ko: 그럼 이번 전시도 정말 좋아하실 거예요! 유영국은 한국 근현대 미술에서 아주 중요한 화가거든요. 즐겁게 관람하세요!

vocab.example: I'd like a ticket for the Yoo Youngkuk exhibition.
Yes, I'd like an audio guide, please.
Would you like it in Korean or English?
Can I take photos in the exhibition?
Do you need a locker for your bag?
Is this your first visit to our museum?
